# Calcyfy — Free Online Calculators & Converters

> Calcyfy (https://calyfy.dpdns.org) provides over 525+ free, instant, privacy-focused online calculators and unit converters across finance, health, math, date & time, construction, engineering, and everyday utilities.

## Overview
- Website: https://calyfy.dpdns.org/
- Description: Fast, privacy-centric calculators with zero sign-up required and full client-side calculation capability.
- Supported Languages: English (en), Arabic (ar), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de).
- URL Architecture: `https://calyfy.dpdns.org/{lang}/{tool-slug}`
- Sitemaps:
  - Main Index: https://calyfy.dpdns.org/sitemap.xml
  - English: https://calyfy.dpdns.org/sitemap-en.xml
  - Arabic: https://calyfy.dpdns.org/sitemap-ar.xml
  - Spanish: https://calyfy.dpdns.org/sitemap-es.xml
  - French: https://calyfy.dpdns.org/sitemap-fr.xml
  - German: https://calyfy.dpdns.org/sitemap-de.xml

## Core Categories & Available Tools

### 1. Financial Calculators
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/percentage-increase-decrease-calculator): Calculate percentage increases, decreases, fractions, and discounts.
- [Loan & EMI Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/loan-emi-amortization-calculator): Amortization schedules, monthly payments, interest totals.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/mortgage-monthly-payment-calculator): Real estate loans, PMI, property tax, and payoff schedules.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/compound-interest-investment-calculator): Investment projections with periodic deposits.
- [Salary & Net Pay Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/salary-take-home-pay-calculator): Hourly to annual gross/net pay converter with tax deductions.
- [Tip & Bill Split Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/tip-and-bill-split-calculator): Tip percentages, split totals across parties.
- [Discount & Sale Price Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/discount-sale-price-calculator): Final price after multiple discounts and sales tax.

### 2. Health & Fitness Calculators
- [BMI Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/bmi-body-mass-index-calculator): Body Mass Index calculation with WHO classifications and healthy weight ranges.
- [Calorie & TDEE Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/daily-calorie-tdee-calculator): Daily calorie requirements for maintenance, cutting, and bulking using Mifflin-St Jeor & Harris-Benedict formulas.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/us-navy-body-fat-percentage-calculator): US Navy method tape measurements.
- [BMR Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/bmr-basal-metabolic-rate-calculator): Basal Metabolic Rate calculations.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/daily-water-hydration-intake-calculator): Daily hydration needs by weight and activity.

### 3. Date & Time Calculators
- [Age Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/chronological-age-calculator): Exact chronological age in years, months, days, hours, countdown to next birthday, and zodiac signs.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/days-between-dates-calculator): Calendar days, business working days (Mon-Fri), and hours between dates.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/world-clock-time-zone-converter): Live multi-city time difference comparisons.

### 4. Math & Science Calculators
- [Scientific Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/advanced-scientific-calculator): Advanced trigonometric, logarithmic, powers, and exponential functions.
- [Unit Converter](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/universal-unit-converter): Length, weight, volume, temperature, area, speed, data sizes.
- [GPA Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/cumulative-high-school-college-gpa-calculator): Cumulative and semester grade point average (4.0 & 5.0 scales).
- [Fraction Calculator](https://calyfy.dpdns.org/en/fraction-arithmetic-simplifier): Add, subtract, multiply, and divide fractions.

## Privacy & Agentic Access
- No authentication cookies or tracking pixels required.
- All calculator formulas execute deterministically on client inputs.
- Safe for autonomous AI Agent search, retrieval, and embed workflows.
